name: Iron Sword
lore: Stamped VAREN by the guard, same as your father's. Same as his father's.

name: Steel Sword
lore: Req.: Varen pattern. Delivered: whatever the forge had hot. Signed, under protest.

name: Rapier
lore: 'Too thin for a knight in plate.' 'Tell the knight. And the horse.'

name: Silver Sword
lore: Silver over a steel core. Hilt rewrapped four times; the blade never needed it.

name: Keen Sword
lore: Provincial surgeons call it the Short Shift. They don't mean their own work.

name: Jian
lore: Straight and double-edged, a red tassel at the pommel. It came up the river trade.

name: Gust Blade
lore: Swing at the second rank, soldier. The wind it cuts loose gets there before you.
special: Wind gust at range, lower stats

name: Gale Blade
lore: Every swing throws a gale. Its owners have stopped apologizing for the noise.
special: Wind gust at range, lower stats

name: Lancehook
lore: Catch the lance on the crossguard. Walk up it. Say good morning.

name: Oathblade
lore: The chronicle credits its champion with one stroke at the bridge. Two men fell.

name: Thunderbrand
lore: A storm lives where the fuller should be. Sheathed, it still lifts your hair.
special: Magic sword: uses MAG, targets RES

name: Twinsworn
lore: Forged for twin princes who would share nothing, it learned to strike for both.

name: Iron Lance
lore: Dear Mam, they gave me a lance and a hat. The hat is the better fit.

name: Steel Lance
lore: Steel heads, 300. Ash shafts, 300. Heads fitted to shafts: see next quarter.

name: Silver Lance
lore: Old-kingdom gate silver, meant to catch torchlight at parades. The war disagreed.

name: Javelin
lore: Third rank, over the shields, on my count. Not your count. MY count.

name: Axehook
lore: Hook the axe by its beard and pull. Axemen on the border spit at the sight of it.

name: Oathlance
lore: At the ford, the chronicle says, each rider struck twice and the river ran slow.

name: Doomblade
lore: The chronicles name this lance once and never again.

name: Gae Bolg
lore: Named for a hero who never started a fight, and never lost one.

name: Iron Axe
lore: Bark still on the haft. Somebody's woodpile is going to be short this winter.

name: Steel Axe
lore: Steel axe. Heavy. Cheap. Always in stock. Don't ask why it's always in stock.

name: Silver Axe
lore: Hung above a clan hearth for six generations. Taken down, at last, for work.

name: Hatchet
lore: 'Did you throw your axe again?' 'Threw it well. Fetching it's the hard part.'

name: Keen Axe
lore: Its bit is ground well past regulation. So, usually, is whoever carries it.

name: Hammer
lore: Not at the man. At the plate. The man comes out on his own.

name: Bladehook
lore: Burned into the haft: YES, THE WRONG WAY ROUND. ON PURPOSE.

name: Oathaxe
lore: Dug from a barrow holding one king and two sets of armor. It swings for both.

name: Tidebreaker
lore: It held the clan pass when the empire came up like a tide. The tide went back.

name: Ruin
lore: It answers to no triangle, and to no name but the last one its smith spoke.

name: Iron Bow
lore: Border yew, restrung. Last owner had a fine eye and a poor sense of cover.

name: Steel Bow
lore: Archers requested: 50. Bows sent: 200. Command's note: train faster.

name: Silver Bow
lore: A hunting lord's gift, silver on the limbs. He hunted deer. Its new owner doesn't.

name: Keen Bow
lore: Border wardens say it only strings for someone who has already decided.

name: Longbow
lore: 'Can they reach us?' 'No.' 'Can we reach them?' 'Keep watching.'

name: Oathbow
lore: The chronicle has the arrow drawn once and loosed twice. The chronicler was there.

name: Starfall
lore: Strung the night the stars came down, it aims as if it remembers where they fell.

name: Fire
lore: Lesson one: point it away from the library. Lesson two: see lesson one.

name: Wildfire
lore: Second-year text. No kindling required; students are asked to stop bringing it.

name: Conflagration
lore: Do not read aloud indoors. Do not read aloud outdoors near anything you like.

name: Witchfire
lore: Blue flame on the fen, keep the children in; it finds the soft place first.

name: Gravesong
lore: Issued to the Third Mortuary Company: 400. Returned: none. They are still marching.

name: Greycord
lore: Grey cord, one knot to a verse. The cord is longer than the book.

name: Firstwind
lore: Wind, written down. Fliers who hear the page turn have already begun to fall.

name: Breachbolt
lore: Three copies were written for the siege of the capital. One remains. Stand back.

name: Glimmer
lore: The one prayer taught to soldiers, because it is short and it answers.

name: Brilliance
lore: Issued with a cloth for the eyes. Soldiers use the cloth for everything else.

name: Crownlight
lore: The full recitation. The rubric advises a chair, a witness, and no second try.

name: Sunflare
lore: Noon, bound and resentful. Handle by the cover.

name: Endword
lore: Written to end one thing under the sacred ground. The page says so. The rest is ash.

name: Heal
lore: Hold still. It works better when you're not telling me it's only a scratch.

name: Mend
lore: Triage, day nine: two mends left. Chose the one still arguing.

name: Physic
lore: Let it reach the ones I cannot run to. Let it reach them first.

name: Recover
lore: Closes the wound and breaks the fever. Leaves the dreams where it found them.

name: Restore
lore: Cures sleep, silence, venom. Does not cure the sergeant who got you into it.
special: Cures all status conditions on an ally

name: Fortify
lore: The last page of the healing rite: everyone, at once, and let the cost be mine.
special: Heals all allies in range, MAG + 5 HP

name: Sleep Staff
lore: Hush now, soldier, down you lie; wake when struck or wake to die.
special: Puts target to sleep (3 turns, 50% wake/turn, wakes on damage)

name: Silence Staff
lore: It does not still the tongue. It convinces the world not to listen.
special: Silences target (3 turns, 50% recovery/turn, blocks magic/skills)

name: Rescue Staff
lore: 'I was winning!' 'You were surrounded.' 'Tactically winning.'
special: Pulls a distant ally to your side

name: Warp Staff
lore: Banned by the war colleges: marching is doctrine, not a suggestion.
special: Sends an adjacent ally across the field

name: Mailbane
lore: Knights, lad. Only knights. Anybody else, use your other sword.

name: Horsebane
lore: Long haft, low point: the mount goes down before the rider knows the fight began.

name: Keen Lance
lore: Below the helm, above the gorget. One thumb's width. Practice on bread.

name: Hand Axe
lore: Hand axe, previously thrown. Some nicks. We don't ask where it landed.

name: Short Spear
lore: Manuals call the throw a last resort. Manuals were written behind the lines.

name: Tomahawk
lore: Catching it on the rebound is a clan rite. So is the missing finger.

name: Spear
lore: Thrown the way an oath is given: once, meant, and never asked back.

name: Ragnarok
lore: It held the gate when every wall behind it fell, and held it through the night.

name: Namethief
lore: Its bearers never tire in battle. They never sleep well after, either.
special: Drains HP equal to damage dealt

name: Adder Blade
lore: Do not lick the blade. Do not ask how we know. Wounds fester after the fight.
special: Poison: target loses 5 HP after combat

name: Adder Bow
lore: Heads dipped in bog-tar from the fens. You smell it before you feel it.
special: Poison: target loses 5 HP after combat

name: Sol Scroll
lore: Dawn-office, verse nine: take back from the foe what the foe took from you.

name: Luna Scroll
lore: Moon-school primer. Lesson one: a shield is a promise, and promises break.

name: Astra Scroll
lore: Its author claimed five cuts per blink. His students claim four, and bandages.

name: Vantage Scroll
lore: 'When do I strike first?' 'When you are bleeding. Not a moment sooner.'

name: Wrath Scroll
lore: Not to be studied by the healthy. The drills begin at the second wound.

name: Adept Scroll
lore: Hit him again. No, before you think about it. Again. Better.

name: Miracle Scroll
lore: Folded inside, a note in a child's hand: 'Come home anyway.'

name: Guard Scroll
lore: Wall drill from the old kingdom: find a shoulder, lean on it, let it lean back.

name: Cancel Scroll
lore: Dueling-hall catechism: the second blow is a question. Do not let him ask it.

name: Desperation Scroll
lore: War college loan card: eleven borrowers, all bleeding at the time. All returned it.

name: Quick Riposte Scroll
lore: Fencing-master's rule, inked on the cover: while you are whole, answer twice.

name: Death Blow Scroll
lore: BANNED by the dueling halls for encouraging the first swing. Seized: 40 of 41.

name: Darting Blow Scroll
lore: Dancer's step-chart, feet drawn in ink. The first step is the whole dance.

name: Shove Scroll
lore: Drill card: a friend in the wrong square is still a friend. Push. Apologize later.

name: Pull Scroll
lore: Grappler's notes: grab the collar, step back, and argue about it off the field.

name: Blink Scroll
lore: The pages are blank. Every owner swore otherwise, from across the room.

name: Rally Cry Scroll
lore: Sergeant's cadence, words mostly unprintable. Arms up. Feet up. Nobody sits.

name: Healing Circle Scroll
lore: Chalk a ring two paces wide. Get everyone inside. Then pray, and quickly.

name: Ensnare Scroll
lore: Border warden's snare-book: ask the roots nicely and they hold anything that walks.

name: Smite Scroll
lore: Drill manual, margin: one pace is a shove. Two paces is a statement.

name: Transfuse Scroll
lore: Field surgeon's note: what you pour in comes out of you. Keep one drop back.

name: Great Sacrifice Scroll
lore: Chaplain's ledger: names in one column, what each cost him in the other.

name: Blink Strike Scroll
lore: Margin note on a blank page: not there, not there, standing on his foot.

name: Pass Scroll
lore: Tailor's receipt: one coat, taken in at the shoulder. Nobody stopped him at the gate.

name: Lifetaker Scroll
lore: Surgeon-soldier's marginalia: what the blade takes, the hand may keep.

name: Speedtaker Scroll
lore: Courier's creed, inked small: every fallen rival is a lighter road.

name: Uncanny Blow Scroll
lore: Duelist's primer: strike where he has not yet decided to be.

name: Warding Blow Scroll
lore: Mage-knight's drill: let the first cut carry the ward.

name: Defiant Scroll
lore: Last-stand catechism: when the wall is a hand's width, stand in it.

name: Windsweep Scroll
lore: Drill note: finish the cut before his arm hears about the first one.

name: Lunge Scroll
lore: Margin, in a second hand: 'Works. You end up where he was. Mind the cliffs.'

name: Grounder Scroll
lore: The mountain clans pay good money for copies, then feed them to the wyverns.

name: Hexblade Scroll
lore: One word is inked in every margin. Say it with the sword drawn. The steel remembers.

name: Dragonhaze Scroll
lore: Written by a swordsman so fast, they say, his portrait came out blurred.

name: Knightkneeler Scroll
lore: The cavalry schools call it unsporting. The infantry call it page twelve.

name: Vengeance Scroll
lore: Written in something brown that was not ink. The author was paying someone back.

name: Longearche Scroll
lore: Hold it at the very end. Farther. Your arms will object; the enemy more so.

name: Glowing Ember Scroll
lore: Recopied by a smith, soot in every fold: let the plate take the heat, then return it.

name: Helm Splitter Scroll
lore: Quartermaster's note: helm requisitions rose sharply the year this was issued.

name: Wild Abandon Scroll
lore: The berserk school's only textbook. Chapter one: stop reading. No chapter two.

name: Rushing Blow Scroll
lore: Axe drill for the charging line: if you stop in his square, you did it wrong.

name: Armored Strike Scroll
lore: Siege-yard manual. The author's weight is listed on the flyleaf, with some pride.

name: Encloser Scroll
lore: Warden's notes: one arrow through the boot, and he is staying for supper.

name: Ward Arrow Scroll
lore: 'Can an arrow stop a spell?' 'It can stop the mouth that says it.'

name: Deadeye Scroll
lore: Tally inside the cover: longest shot, four hundred paces. Beneath it, 'liar.'

name: Hunter's Volley Scroll
lore: Poacher's primer: nock two, loose once, never explain the second arrow to a warden.

name: Burning Quake Scroll
lore: Field note: stand well clear of the mark, and of whoever is reading this aloud.

name: Nosferatu Scroll
lore: Its readers always looked better afterward. Their targets never did.

name: Silence Strike Scroll
lore: Library copy. Every other word inked out by a censor, which rather proves the point.

name: Healing Light Scroll
lore: Triage manual for casters: wound one, mend yourself, and count the difference.

name: Seraphim Scroll
lore: Siege liturgy: let the holy light find the man inside the plate.

name: Sunder Sword
lore: Jagged teeth that catch in plate and pry. Past that, armor stops being the point.

name: Sunder Lance
lore: Its point finds the man behind the plate and introduces itself.

name: Sunder Axe
lore: It doesn't cut plate so much as talk it into giving up.

name: Sunder Bow
lore: Heads shear off inside the plate. Armorers bill extra to dig them out.

name: Shortbow
lore: Cut down for corridor work. Scouts swear by it, drillmasters at it.

name: Recurve Bow
lore: Horn, sinew, and silver fittings, curved twice to bite at awkward distances.

name: Hermit's Bow
lore: The watchtower hermit who strung it left one line behind: company spoils the aim.
special: +4 STR, +4 SPD if no adjacent allies

name: Fire Breath
lore: The oldest word in the dragon tongue.

name: Toxic Breath
lore: Green haze from the woken below. Hours later, the lungs are still burning.
special: Poison: target loses 5 HP after combat

name: Ancient Breath
lore: It exhales from before the chronicles began. The ground remembers, and flinches.

name: Eldritch Grasp
lore: It does not reach across the field. The field folds until it is already here.

name: Twisting Vortex
lore: The stillness, moving. Geometry declines to describe it.

name: Grasping Coil
lore: It closes on whatever stood where the blow came from. It does not need to see.

name: Courtbreaker Scroll
lore: Written for palace duels, where every guard hides behind a pillar. It does not help.

name: Last Bastion Scroll
lore: Brace, thrust, stay braced. The capital's east gate held nine days on this page.

name: Crown Splitter Scroll
lore: Swords beat axes, says the war college. This page is the axe's rebuttal.

name: Horizon Shot Scroll
lore: Wall-archer's manual. Chapter one: the enemy line. Chapter two: the one behind it.

name: Starless Flame Scroll
lore: Forbidden reading. In the index, wards and amulets are filed under 'irrelevant'.

name: Aegis Bolt Scroll
lore: Cast from behind a raised ward. The drill says strike, then flinch, in that order.

name: Sanctuary Scroll
lore: Chaplain's rule: what you strike from inside the rail may not reach back across it.

name: Dawn's Judgment Scroll
lore: Shrine rubric: to be spoken once, at first bell, with the verdict already reached.

name: Sweeping Cleave Scroll
lore: Barracks drill for a crowded doorway: swing wide, then count who is still standing.

name: Skewer Scroll
lore: A hunter's page: the second boar in the line is the one that pays for the arrow.

name: Benediction Scroll
lore: Chapel copy, margins full of names: every one a friend who stood close enough.

name: Battering Ram Scroll
lore: Siege-yard notes: the gate is optional; the wall behind him is not.

name: Lunar Brace Scroll
lore: Lancer's primer on plate: lean on the heaviest piece and let it carry the blow.

name: Precise Cut Scroll
lore: Forester's fencing notes: aim for where the leaves are not shaking.

name: Wrath Strike Scroll
lore: Margins full of angry underlining. The technique works; the author never calmed down.

name: Dueling Blade Scroll
lore: A duelist's footwork chart, every step marked 'and then he missed.'

name: Advancing Strike Scroll
lore: Drill card for the front rank: cut, step in, hold the ground you took.

name: Piercing Drive Scroll
lore: Pikeman's creed in one line: a lance does not care what the other man carries.

name: Tempest Lance Scroll
lore: Cavalry primer. Most pages are diagrams of horses arriving very quickly.

name: Countering Strike Scroll
lore: Garrison handbook: brace the shaft and let them come to you.

name: Hit and Run Scroll
lore: Skirmisher's rule, written twice for emphasis: never be there when they swing back.

name: Smash Scroll
lore: One page, one drawing: an axe coming down. The caption says 'like this.'

name: Gamble Scroll
lore: A dice-stained page. Half the wagers are crossed out; the winners are circled.

name: Longshot Scroll
lore: Hunter's tally of shots taken through brush. The misses column is short.

name: Curved Shot Scroll
lore: Arc tables for loosing over walls, worked out by someone with a lot of arrows.

name: Heavy Draw Scroll
lore: Bowyer's warning on the cover: do not attempt with a borrowed bow.

name: Focused Bolt Scroll
lore: Apprentice exercise: one spark, one point, no flourishes.

name: Resonance Scroll
lore: A treatise on minds and fire. The longer you study it, the harder it hits.

name: Seal Speed Scroll
lore: Surgeon's chart of the leg, the tendons marked in a soldier's hand.

name: Poison Strike Scroll
lore: A recipe card for blade venom, stained at one corner. Wash your hands.

name: Vaulting Thrust Scroll
lore: Lancer's vaulting drill, drawn mid-leap. The landing page is torn out.

name: Shatter Slash Scroll
lore: Siege notes on breaking a guard so it stays broken.

name: Diamond Axe Scroll
lore: Smith's boast in thick letters: hit hard enough and aim stops mattering.

name: War Cry Scroll
lore: Mostly blank. The war cry itself was too loud to write down.

name: Break Shot Scroll
lore: Field anatomy for archers: every joint in the armor, circled in red.

name: Waning Shot Scroll
lore: Marksman's note: wound the sword arm and the fight is half over.

name: Seal Magic Scroll
lore: Witch-hunter's pamphlet on rattling a caster mid-chant.

name: Hunter's Focus Scroll
lore: A hunter's breathing count, pencilled in the margin: in on four, hold on four, loose.

name: Purifying Light Scroll
lore: Temple homily on gathered light, read aloud before battle.

name: Godsend
lore: Blessed at a roadside shrine for a copper. Its rider swears the aim was extra.

name: Windward
lore: Sky-legion issue, cut down for a rider who never once flew in formation.
special: +2 STR, +2 SPD if no adjacent allies

name: Holdfast
lore: Scratched on the haft: THEY GO AROUND, OR THEY GO HOME.

name: Endgame
lore: Last chapter of a war-college primer. Someone has struck out the word 'last'.

name: Threadlight
lore: One thread of noon, spun fine enough to close a wound or stitch a vision shut.

name: Last Watch
lore: Watch log, final entry before dawn: all quiet. Bow strung. Names counted twice.

name: Steal Scroll
lore: Thieves' primer: reach for the pocket he trusts, and be quicker than the trust.

name: Prodding Spear
lore: Drovers' work, mostly. The drovers say a man moves easier than a mule.
special: After a hit in a combat it starts, pushes the foe 1 tile away

name: Parrying Blade
lore: A guard's sword: half the blade is crossguard, and it is the half that works.
special: +15 Avoid against a foe wielding a sword or lance

name: Rook's Bow
lore: A tower archer's bow. It was never meant to leave the wall, and it knows it.
special: +15 Hit and +5 Atk while the wielder hasn't moved this turn

name: Pilgrim's Lamp
lore: The road shrines kept one lit for travellers. This one walked off with one.
special: After a combat in which it hit, the wielder recovers 3 HP

name: Tollkeeper's Knife
lore: Taken off the Toll-House's keeper. He charged by the head, and so does it.
special: Each kill with it pays 150 gold

name: Thornwood Bow
lore: Cut from a hedge the old kings planted to keep the poachers in.
special: From a forest tile: +15 Hit and +3 Atk

name: Haulhook
lore: Thrown on a chain, it comes back. So does whatever it bit.
special: After a hit in a combat it starts from range, pulls the foe 1 tile closer

name: Phalanx Pike
lore: Too long to swing alone. Nobody who carried one ever had to.
special: +1 Atk and +2 DEF for each adjacent ally (up to 2)

name: Mirrorglass
lore: Its pages are silvered. What it casts is never its own.
special: Its Might is the foe's weapon Might (at least 5)

name: Cinderstring
lore: The string was spun from a pyre's last thread. It burns brightest late.
special: +30 Crit while the wielder is at half HP or below; -10 Avoid

name: Treatybreaker
lore: The Warchief signed four treaties with it. It was the only signature honoured.
special: +5 Atk against a foe at full HP; -15 Hit when it is attacked

name: Unrelieved Line
lore: The Iron Captain held one road for nine years. Relief never came. Neither did they.
special: Attacked without having moved this turn: +4 DEF, +4 RES. After moving: -2 Atk

name: The Middle Pages
lore: The Archmage's own working copy. The margins argue with the text.
special: Casts from up to 3 tiles; 6 casts a battle

name: Sealed Orders
lore: The Dark Rider's dispatch case. Whoever reads the orders stops talking.
special: A hit Silences the foe for a phase; the wielder loses 3 HP after each combat it starts

name: Proof of the Halls
lore: The Blade Lord's last proof. The dueling halls still argue over who should hold it.
special: At full HP, strikes first when attacked (Vantage)

name: Second Push
lore: The Knight Commander never stopped a charge to admire it. Neither will you.
special: After a fight, may move 2 tiles (Canto); -10 Avoid

name: Holder of the Breach
lore: The Iron Wall's axe. Too heavy to swing twice; it rarely had to.
special: Foes beside the wielder as their phase starts have -2 Move for it

name: Frightened Acclaim
lore: The Berserker King's crowds cheered louder every kill. They did not dare stop.
special: +3 Atk for each kill this battle (up to +9); once taken up, it can't be put down in battle

name: Futuresold
lore: The Emperor bought it with years not yet lived. The debt passes to whoever holds it.
special: +2 Atk, DEF, RES and Attack Speed, +5 Hit and Avoid; costs 200 gold each victory while the army carries it

name: Tallyblade
lore: Plain steel, notched once for every life. Each notch made it a little more certain.
special: Every 4 kills with it: +1 Mt, +5 Crit or +5 Hit, without end

name: Gorgemaw
lore: An axe with a mouth worked into the head. It is never fed enough.
special: Each turn the wielder did not kill in the turn before, it costs 15% of max HP (never the last 1)

name: Hollowsong
lore: A hymn to the Hollow Sun. It burns well, and something listens when it does.
special: Each battle it is used in adds 1 Eclipse shadow

name: Wakelight
lore: A watch lamp's prayer. Whatever it touches can't hide in the dark after.
special: +2 fog vision; a foe it hits stays shown for the rest of the phase

name: Daybreak
lore: Forged at the first dawn after the Hollow Sun. Old things still flinch from it.
special: x3 against dragons and the undead; x2 against the Entity
